exposure.needed: whether the environment uses IPsec with single key configuration (+ sign in secrets)

consequence.statement: IPsec configurations using single key mode will automatically transition to per-tunnel keys; tunnel behavior may change depending on the per-tunnel key configuration.

assertion.statement: IPsec single key support (indicated by the + sign in secrets) has been removed; per-tunnel keys are now always used regardless of the + sign's presence.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for protocol-behavior removed
